system.description:
Brawlers are rough-and-tumble fighters who rely on muscle, reflexes, and sheer determination. From Vesten dockside enforcers to Ussuran tavern bruisers and Eisen mercenaries, they’ve learned to use their fists to affect the world. They fight with stubborn grit, striking where it counts.

STARTING EVASION: 10
STARTING HP: 6

Thematic Items

A pair of bloodstained knuckle-dusters, or a lover's keepsake

Brawler's Hope Feature

Staggering Blow. Spend 3 Hope when you hit an adversary to force them to mark a Stress and leave them temporarily Reeling. While Reeling, all their rolls are made at disadvantage.

Archetype Feature

Living Weapon

While you fight bare-handed or with improvised weapons:

  • Your Evasion has a +1 bonus.
  • Your unarmed strikes are considered Melee weapons, use the trait of your choice, and deal d8+d6 physical damage.
Just You & Me

While there are no other adversaries within Very Close of your target, you gain a +2 bonus to your attack and damage rolls against them. In addition, you ignore the target's damage redunction effects, if any.
backgroundQuestions: Where did you first learn to rely on your fists?
Who or what did you promise to stand up for when no one else would, and how has that shaped you?
What scar, broken bone, or old beating taught you the hardest lesson?
connections: Why did we fight, and how did it change the way we see each other?
What trouble do you always count on me to handle, and why do you trust me to do it?
What have I done that's so insane that you'll remember forever?
